items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I got tired of that and I went to live with her.

ctx.x: Her name was Jesse Knight. She was from Montgomery, she was a very fair woman, very -- the red hair, long red hair, and her father was -- reminded me of Santa Claus. He had a flowing white beard, and he was -- well, he was white, you know, really. And when I went to New York I told you I stayed at the Woodside, was my first place to stay. And I got tired of that and I went to live with her.
Did she work professionally for you?
